extracted.intended_audience: advanced undergraduate and graduate students in mathematics; readers studying real and complex analysis, inequalities, and combinatorics
extracted.subtask_description: An expository textbook chapter presenting fundamental inequalities (Cauchy–Schwarz, AM-GM, harmonic/geometric/arithmetic means), applications to polynomials (Laguerre, P6lya, Chebyshev) and combinatorial lemmas (Littlewood–Offord, Sperner, Kleitman). Intended for learning proofs, techniques, and applications in analysis and combinatorics.
